page.overview:
What is Hoppers?

Hoppers is a feature film produced by Pixar Animation Studios. It was announced at the D23 conference on August 9, 2024. It was released in theaters on March 6, 2026 and Pixar's thirtieth feature film.

At an elementary school in Beaverton, a young girl, Mabel takes several class pets in an attempt to let them escape, but accidentally sets off a fire sprinkler and gets in trouble. Shortly after, Mabel visits her grandmother and they take a walk to a forest glade inhabited by many wild animals. Inspired by her grandmother, Mabel develops a deep appreciation of nature and continues to watch the glade after her grandmother's death.

Years later, when the city's mayor, Jerry announces plans to replace the glade with a freeway, claiming all the animals have left. Mabel attempts to rebel against the plans, but she ends up receiving no support. Her dedication to saving the glade causes her to miss her university studies, much to the frustration of her science professor, Dr. Sam. However, Dr. Sam asserts that beavers could save the glade.

Later that night, while attempting to lure a beaver to the glade, Mabel sees it getting taken and chases it into a lab in the university, where it is revealed that Dr. Sam and her colleagues developed "Hoppers", a technology that allows humans to "hop" the minds of life-like robotic animals to experience the world from their perspective. Seeing this as the opportunity to save the glade, Mabel goes into the mind of the robot beaver against Dr. Sam's wishes and escapes the lab and her peers, only to be snatched up by an owl and dropped into the glade.
